rules.name: Monkey King Bar
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Monkey King Bar: each attack has an 80% chance to pierce evasion and deal 70 bonus magical damage (+50 damage, +50 attack speed). It is in her build (25% at ~26 min); against Phantom Assassin or Windranger 27% of 30 games (18% otherwise), won 50% against 41%: earlier.

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: take {item} from your build earlier, 80% of your attacks with it go through the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: візьміть {item} зі своєї збірки раніше, з ним 80% ваших атак проходять крізь ухилення

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: wraith_band 27% (1), null_talisman 54% (2), magic_wand 28% (3), power_treads 100% (6), desolator 93% (12), dragon_lance 81% (14), lesser_crit 79% (20), greater_crit 70% (24), aghanims_shard 25% (24), monkey_king_bar 25% (26), force_staff 42% (26), hurricane_pike 40% (26), black_king_bar 24% (28).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 75.0%+: 30:00 21500 (25 games, 80.0%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold; points under 20 games left out.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
